1: """
   2: Format Grammar Validator for AutoVideoPipeline.
   3: Strictly enforces the canonical Five Formats (F1-F5) source grammar and failure matrix.
   4: Raises FORMAT_GRAMMAR_VIOLATION on any source class or structure breach.
   5: """
   6: from typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional
   7: from .models import FormatId, SourceClass, FormatPlan, VisualSegment, LayoutProfile
   8: 
   9: 
  10: class FORMAT_GRAMMAR_VIOLATION(ValueError):
  11:     """Raised when timeline composition violates the bound format's product contract."""
  12:     pass
  13: 
  14: 
  15: class FormatValidator:
  16:     """
  17:     Validates that a timeline schedule complies with the selected FormatPlan
  18:     prior to Stage 3 finalization and Stage 4 rendering.
  19:     """
  20: 
  21:     @staticmethod
  22:     def validate_timeline(segments: List[VisualSegment], format_plan: FormatPlan) -> Dict[str, Any]:
  23:         """
  24:         Validates the visual segments against the FormatPlan grammar.
  25:         Raises FORMAT_GRAMMAR_VIOLATION on any breach.
  26:         """
  27:         if not segments:
  28:             raise FORMAT_GRAMMAR_VIOLATION("Timeline is empty. Full visual coverage is required.")
  29: 
  30:         fmt = format_plan.format_id
  31: 
  32:         # Normalize segment source class mapping
  33:         for seg in segments:
  34:             if not seg.source_class:
  35:                 seg.source_class = FormatValidator._infer_source_class(seg)
  36: 
  37:         if fmt == FormatId.F1:
  38:             return FormatValidator._validate_f1(segments, format_plan)
  39:         elif fmt == FormatId.F2:
  40:             return FormatValidator._validate_f2(segments, format_plan)
  41:         elif fmt == FormatId.F3:
  42:             return FormatValidator._validate_f3(segments, format_plan)
  43:         elif fmt == FormatId.F4:
  44:             return FormatValidator._validate_f4(segments, format_plan)
  45:         elif fmt == FormatId.F5:
  46:             return FormatValidator._validate_f5(segments, format_plan)
  47:         else:
  48:             raise FORMAT_GRAMMAR_VIOLATION(f"Unsupported format: {fmt}")
  49: 
  50:     @staticmethod
  51:     def _infer_source_class(seg: VisualSegment) -> SourceClass:
  52:         t = seg.segment_type.lower()
  53:         if t in ("chap1_opening", "veo_opening", "veo_ai", "veo"):
  54:             return SourceClass.GENERATED_VIDEO
  55:         elif t in ("slideshow", "image", "f1_fullscreen"):
  56:             return SourceClass.GENERATED_IMAGE
  57:         elif t in ("stock", "stock_opening"):
  58:             return SourceClass.STOCK_ONLINE
  59:         elif t in ("f1_framed", "reup", "original_source"):
  60:             return SourceClass.ORIGINAL_REUP_VIDEO
  61:         raise FORMAT_GRAMMAR_VIOLATION(
  62:             f"Cannot verify source class for segment {seg.index} ({seg.segment_type})"
  63:         )
  64: 
  65:     @staticmethod
  66:     def _validate_f1(segments: List[VisualSegment], plan: FormatPlan) -> Dict[str, Any]:
  67:         """
  68:         F1: AI Opening (Veo) + AI Images (Flow).
  69:         Stock video is strictly forbidden in normal F1 semantics.
  70:         """
  71:         opening_segs = [s for s in segments if s.segment_type in ("chap1_opening", "veo_opening")]
  72:         if not opening_segs:
  73:             # Fallback to first segment as opening
  74:             opening_segs = [segments[0]]
  75:             body_segs = segments[1:]
  76:         else:
  77:             body_segs = [s for s in segments if s not in opening_segs]
  78: 
  79:         for s in opening_segs:
  80:             if s.source_class != SourceClass.GENERATED_VIDEO:
  81:                 raise FORMAT_GRAMMAR_VIOLATION(
  82:                     f"F1 requires AI Opening video (GENERATED_VIDEO), found: {s.source_class.value}"
  83:                 )
  84: 
  85:         if not body_segs:
  86:             raise FORMAT_GRAMMAR_VIOLATION("F1 timeline contains no body segments.")
  87: 
  88:         for seg in body_segs:
  89:             if seg.source_class == SourceClass.STOCK_ONLINE:
  90:                 raise FORMAT_GRAMMAR_VIOLATION(
  91:                     f"F1 rejects STOCK_ONLINE in main program at segment {seg.index}: {seg.description}"
  92:                 )
  93:             if seg.source_class != SourceClass.GENERATED_IMAGE:
  94:                 raise FORMAT_GRAMMAR_VIOLATION(
  95:                     f"F1 requires GENERATED_IMAGE in main program, found: {seg.source_class.value} at segment {seg.index}"
  96:                 )
  97: 
  98:         return {"valid": True, "format": "F1", "segments_count": len(segments)}
  99: 
 100:     @staticmethod
 101:     def _validate_f2(segments: List[VisualSegment], plan: FormatPlan) -> Dict[str, Any]:
 102:         """
 103:         F2: AI Opening + Stock + AI Video.
 104:         post_opening_mix_semantics = BOTH_CLASSES_REQUIRED.
 105:         Timeline must contain >= 1 intentional STOCK_ONLINE interval
 106:         AND >= 1 intentional post-opening GENERATED_VIDEO interval.
 107:         """
 108:         opening_seg = segments[0]
 109:         if opening_seg.source_class != SourceClass.GENERATED_VIDEO:
 110:             raise FORMAT_GRAMMAR_VIOLATION(
 111:                 f"F2 requires AI Opening video (GENERATED_VIDEO), found: {opening_seg.source_class.value}"
 112:             )
 113: 
 114:         post_opening = segments[1:]
 115:         if not post_opening:
 116:             raise FORMAT_GRAMMAR_VIOLATION("F2 timeline contains no post-opening segments.")
 117: 
 118:         stock_count = 0
 119:         ai_video_count = 0
 120: 
 121:         for seg in post_opening:
 122:             if seg.source_class == SourceClass.STOCK_ONLINE:
 123:                 stock_count += 1
 124:             elif seg.source_class == SourceClass.GENERATED_VIDEO:
 125:                 ai_video_count += 1
 126:             else:
 127:                 raise FORMAT_GRAMMAR_VIOLATION(
 128:                     f"F2 post-opening forbids {seg.source_class.value} at segment {seg.index}. Allowed: {{STOCK_ONLINE, GENERATED_VIDEO}}"
 129:                 )
 130: 
 131:         if stock_count < 1:
 132:             raise FORMAT_GRAMMAR_VIOLATION(
 133:                 "F2 requires at least 1 intentional STOCK_ONLINE interval (BOTH_CLASSES_REQUIRED). Found 0."
 134:             )
 135:         if ai_video_count < 1:
 136:             raise FORMAT_GRAMMAR_VIOLATION(
 137:                 "F2 requires at least 1 intentional post-opening GENERATED_VIDEO interval (BOTH_CLASSES_REQUIRED). Found 0."
 138:             )
 139: 
 140:         return {
 141:             "valid": True,
 142:             "format": "F2",
 143:             "stock_intervals": stock_count,
 144:             "ai_video_intervals": ai_video_count
 145:         }
 146: 
 147:     @staticmethod
 148:     def _validate_f3(segments: List[VisualSegment], plan: FormatPlan) -> Dict[str, Any]:
 149:         """
 150:         F3: Full AI Images.
 151:         Zero stock video, zero AI video opening.
 152:         """
 153:         for seg in segments:
 154:             if seg.source_class in (SourceClass.STOCK_ONLINE, SourceClass.GENERATED_VIDEO, SourceClass.ORIGINAL_REUP_VIDEO):
 155:                 raise FORMAT_GRAMMAR_VIOLATION(
 156:                     f"F3 requires 100% GENERATED_IMAGE. Found forbidden {seg.source_class.value} at segment {seg.index}"
 157:                 )
 158: 
 159:         return {"valid": True, "format": "F3", "segments_count": len(segments)}
 160: 
 161:     @staticmethod
 162:     def _validate_f4(segments: List[VisualSegment], plan: FormatPlan) -> Dict[str, Any]:
 163:         """
 164:         F4: Reup.
 165:         Online background video + original source video displayed smaller/inset.
 166:         LayoutProfile must not obscure source video or hide background.
 167:         """
 168:         layout: Optional[LayoutProfile] = plan.layout_profile
 169:         if not layout:
 170:             raise FORMAT_GRAMMAR_VIOLATION("F4 Reup requires a bound LayoutProfile.")
 171: 
 172:         if layout.foreground_scale >= 1.0 or layout.foreground_scale <= 0.1:
 173:             raise FORMAT_GRAMMAR_VIOLATION(
 174:                 f"F4 LayoutProfile geometry invalid: foreground_scale={layout.foreground_scale}. Must be between 0.1 and 0.95."
 175:             )
 176: 
 177:         original_segments = [seg for seg in segments if seg.source_class == SourceClass.ORIGINAL_REUP_VIDEO]
 178:         stock_segments = [seg for seg in segments if seg.source_class == SourceClass.STOCK_ONLINE]
 179:         if not original_segments:
 180:             raise FORMAT_GRAMMAR_VIOLATION("F4 Reup requires an ORIGINAL_REUP_VIDEO source file.")
 181:         if not stock_segments:
 182:             raise FORMAT_GRAMMAR_VIOLATION("F4 Reup requires visible STOCK_ONLINE background footage.")
 183:         return {"valid": True, "format": "F4", "layout_id": layout.layout_id}
 184: 
 185:     @staticmethod
 186:     def _validate_f5(segments: List[VisualSegment], plan: FormatPlan) -> Dict[str, Any]:
 187:         """
 188:         F5: Full Custom Video.
 189:         100% STOCK_ONLINE footage for the full visual program.
 190:         Zero Flow images, zero Flow video, zero arbitrary local media.
 191:         """
 192:         for seg in segments:
 193:             if seg.source_class != SourceClass.STOCK_ONLINE:
 194:                 raise FORMAT_GRAMMAR_VIOLATION(
 195:                     f"F5 rejects {seg.source_class.value} at segment {seg.index}. Allowed: STOCK_ONLINE only."
 196:                 )
 197: 
 198:         return {"valid": True, "format": "F5", "stock_segments": len(segments)}

 200:     @staticmethod
 201:     def handle_source_failure(
 202:         format_id: FormatId,
 203:         failure_phase: str,  # "opening", "main_stock", "main_ai_video", "main_ai_image", "background"
 204:         attempts: int,
 205:         max_attempts: int = 2,
 206:         current_stock_count: int = 0
 207:     ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
 208:         """
 209:         Implements the canonical required-source failure matrix.
 210:         Never mutates format identity in place.
 211:         """
 212:         if attempts < max_attempts:
 213:             return {
 214:                 "disposition": "RETRY_SAME_SOURCE",
 215:                 "message": f"Bounded retry attempt {attempts + 1}/{max_attempts} for {failure_phase}"
 216:             }
 217: 
 218:         # Exhausted retries
 219:         if format_id == FormatId.F2 and failure_phase == "main_stock":
 220:             # F2 stock interval NO_MATCH can route to GENERATED_VIDEO only if
 221:             # the remaining timeline still has >= 1 stock interval and remains F2 compliant
 222:             if current_stock_count > 1:
 223:                 return {
 224:                     "disposition": "ROUTE_TO_GENERATED_VIDEO",
 225:                     "message": "Routing single stock interval to GENERATED_VIDEO while preserving F2 BOTH_CLASSES_REQUIRED"
 226:                 }
 227: 
 228:         # All other failure states must escalate without silent format mutation
 229:         return {
 230:             "disposition": "NEEDS_OWNER_OR_FAIL",
 231:             "message": f"Source failure in {format_id.value} during {failure_phase}. Escalated to owner."
 232:         }
